description: Localization style: sort Polish surnames per the Polish alphabet without using the OS locale. Plain code-point or lowercase sorting puts a-with-ogonek, l-with-stroke and the acute and dotted z after the whole Latin alphabet, and stripping diacritics loses the order between a and a-with-ogonek, so the agent must build an explicit collation key, keep case-insensitive ties stable and treat space and hyphen as lower than letters. All surnames are synthetic.
